source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Yes, that is right. The main board includes:

- ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 module
- INA219 current monitor on the 3.3V rail
- USB-C connector for programming, plus an LDO for standalone operation
- Every JST connector for the power board, sensor board, display, PIR, touch, LEDs, buttons, and reset
- Supporting passives, including decoupling caps, pull-ups, series resistors, Schottky diodes, and the BOOT button

It has no sensors or power management, as those are located on the other boards.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes, there is also a reset button, a switch, and I think 2 additional buttons.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Complete list:

- J\_BTN3 — panel-mounted button using GPIO6
- J\_BTN4 — panel-mounted button using GPIO7
- J\_SW — panel slide switch using GPIO8
- J\_RESET — panel reset button connecting EN to GND
- J\_TOUCH — capacitive touch using TTP223, on GPIO11
- J\_TOUCH2 — capacitive touch using TTP223, on GPIO14
- BOOT button — located only on the board for development and not mounted on the panel

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: They attach through connectors; boot is the only button physically located on the board.
